# Unvalidated JSONB payloads and unbounded content

Multiple columns store free-form JSONB (payload, extraction, artifact_refs, change_summary, output) with no schema enforced here. Without application-level validation, these fields can carry arbitrarily large or malformed content, posing risks for storage bloat and unexpected consumers.
